review.notes: Full re-review. Earlier remarks: the locator of 5.4 repaired, five corrections and two format notes still open (C01-C06, N01-N02). Seeded sample of 15 targets read against KL15, R16, S00, S03, VPR07, RSZ13, K16, the S24 preprint and three Stacks Project chapters; published S24 and A57 not readable. All displayed identities and worked examples recomputed, the rank-two Schlesinger example in exact arithmetic in both orders. Suggested.lean elaborates with two sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes close neither theorem; the hypothesis q ≠ 0 of the gauge identity is unused (proved without it in a scratch copy). 71 cross-roadmap section citations resolved on main, including the new PhiGammaModulesAndIwasawaCohomology 0.1-0.2; dependency check 0 problems; no change outside the folder. Automatic checks: the import-form failures are a format note (N01); three reports set aside as false positives.
